messages:
jordan (partnerships): Hi all — VaultWave reached out about a joint integration: marketplace listing + secrets sync connector. Scope: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk import), secrets exchange using partner-wrapped HSM blobs, and an audit webhook. Can we assign owners and list blockers? :wave:

mei (product): I can own the marketplace listing and install UX. I need a short blurb, long blurb, tags (SAML, SCIM, KMS), logo assets (SVG + 2x PNG), and screenshots of their admin UI. Also: do they support SCIM PATCH and bulk CSV import?

vaultwave-ps: We support SCIM PATCH and bulk CSV import. We'll provide screenshots and a sandbox with 5k users. We can also expose an enterprise webhook for lead capture. Embargo: Jun 4 08:00 PT.

ajay (security): I'll take KMS/HSM validation and threat modeling. VaultWave uses a hosted FIPS HSM (VaultHSM) — they said they'll share attestation. I need the attestation PDF, key-wrap API spec (wrap/unwrap), supported algorithms (RSA-OAEP, AES-GCM, AES-KW), TLS cert chain, and a read-only test key for wrap operations. Also request their rotation cadence and incident contact.

lucas (eng): I'll own SAML runtime and SCIM integration tests. Need IdP metadata, sample SAML assertions, ACS URLs, expected NameID format, and example SCIM error codes (esp 429 behavior). I'll add toggleable CI checks in partner-integration tests. Quick SAML curl for them to fetch our SP metadata:

`curl -sS https://sp.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata > sp-metadata.xml`

mei (product): For install flow, we should support Quick Install (token-based) and Enterprise Install (SAML + assisted key exchange). Also confirm whether partner prefers partner-wrapped blobs (they wrap secrets and we store wrapped blob) or runtime wrap/unwarp calls. UX differs either way.

vaultwave-ps: We prefer partner-wrapped blobs for least-privilege. We'll provide an unwrap API with RBAC scopes and an event stream of unwraps. We'll include a key versioning header for rotation mapping.

ajay (security): Partner-wrapped is preferred. Please include TTL semantics and emergency-unwrap policy. We'll require an audit webhook for unwrap events. Also request sample logs showing unwrap events and RBAC scopes.

lucas (eng): SCIM snippet I'll use for tests:

POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{
  "userName": "a.chen",
  "displayName": "A Chen",
  "emails": [{"value":"a.chen@vaultwave.com"}]
}

And a SCIM PATCH to add a user to a group:

PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{ "Operations": [ { "op": "Add", "value": { "members": [ { "value": "a.chen" } ] } } ] }

Please attach sample 429 bodies and retry-after header behavior.

mei (product): Marketplace assets needed: short blurb (<=140 chars), long blurb (2-4 sentences), categories/tags, logo, screenshots, install time estimate, pricing tiers. I'll draft a blurb and share for review once I have screenshots.

tess (legal): We'll need logo/trademark approvals and co-marketing copy. If they want a joint press release, send legal-approved boilerplate and embargo details. Also ask for a draft DPA if their sandbox contains any customer PII.

vaultwave-ps: We'll send sandbox creds, IdP metadata, attestation, logo/brand kit, and DPA draft by EOD Wed. We'll also provide a read-only wrap-test key.

ajay (security): Technical wrap test we want them to run and paste output (base64):

curl -X POST https://sandbox.vaultwave.com/kms/wrap
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap-1","plaintext":"VGhpcyBpcyB0ZXN0IGJsb2I="}'

We will verify unwrap returns original plaintext and that wrapped blob metadata includes `kid` and `alg` headers.

ci-bot: draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/842 (placeholder listing + install guide stub).

jordan (partnerships): Action items summary:
- VaultWave -> send IdP metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, HSM attestation, DPA draft, logo + screenshots by Wed EOD (vaultwave-ps confirmed).
- ajay -> schedule 30m threat-model after attestation arrives (target Thu).
- lucas -> add SAML + SCIM smoke tests to partner CI (toggleable).
- mei -> draft marketplace copy and screenshot requests.
- tess -> prepare legal checklist and review DPA when received.

vaultwave-ps: Confirmed. We'll aim for Wed EOD delivery and stand by for the security call.

mei (product): Tentative timeline: Wed artifacts -> Thu security call -> Mon internal dry-run -> Jun 4 embargo lift. If any DPA/legal delays, push internal dry-run accordingly.

ajay (security): One more ask: please provide example unwrap audit event (JSON) so we can map to our observability pipeline. Sample fields we expect: `timestamp`, `actor`, `key_id`, `action`, `request_id`, `result` (success/fail).

vaultwave-ps: We'll attach a sample event JSON and the webhook HMAC secret for verification to the sandbox package.

jordan (partnerships): Great — I'll schedule the calls and share a short calendar invite with agenda. Ping me or @ajay if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
